name: Origin-centered sphere r30 mm
notes: Expected probes are analytic: volume = 4/3*pi*r^3, surface = 4*pi*r^2. Degenerate edges stay in the AEMB edge table with zero polyline vertices so mesh edge identity matches the B-rep edge count.
